title: A Nested Amplitude Amplification Protocol for the Binary Knapsack Problem
summary: Amplitude Amplification offers a provable speedup for search problems, which is leveraged in combinatorial optimization by Grover Adaptive Search (GAS). The protocol demands deep circuits that are challenging with regards to NISQ capabilities. We propose a nested Amplitude Amplification protocol for the binary knapsack problem that splits the decision tree at a tunable depth, performing a partial amplification on the first variables before executing a global GAS on the full search space.
